rules.name: Q4 2026 5% Cashback Bonus categories: Restaurants, Entertainment, Utilities
rules.eligibility_notes: Restaurants: full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations, caterers; restaurants inside hotels or retail stores and bakeries may not qualify. Entertainment: movie theaters, sports/theatrical/concert promoters, amusement parks, tourist attractions, aquariums, zoos, dance halls, record stores, video rental, pool halls, bowling alleys; excludes golf courses, country clubs, some collegiate sporting events, charitable events, cable and digital streaming and subscription services, amusement park tickets bought on third-party sites, and entertainment or resort packages categorized as travel or hotel. Utilities: residential electricity, natural gas, water, and phone or online purchases of internet, cable, satellite TV, and mobile or landline phone service; purchases at physical retail stores do not qualify; purchases through a landlord, property manager or HOA, home fuel delivery, standalone streaming, some satellite phone and internet service, and vehicle connectivity, accessories or equipment may not qualify. Merchant must be in the U.S. and qualification depends on merchant category code; some third-party payment and digital wallet transactions may not earn 5%. 5% cash back on up to $1,500 in combined purchases in the quarter (maximum $75 cash back), then 1%; activation required and earning begins on the later of 10/1/26 or the activation date.
